data.change_summary: Applied both pending amendments: (1) Added `alk_budget` decrement after the comammox step in nitrogen_cycle.rs for consistency with the `do_budget` pattern — assigned to `_alk_budget` since NOB does not currently read it, with a comment explaining the intent for future guilds; (2) Replaced `serde_json::from_str::<SaveFile>(&raw)` with `SaveFile::from_json(&raw)` in the TUI `load_from_disk` method so disk loads go through the migration-aware constructor, ensuring version validation, migration chain application, and proper stability_tracker reseeding.
outstanding_risks: The v2→v3 migration is frozen as raw-JSON logic independent of WaterState::rescale_totals_for_volume; this is by design for migration immutability (carried forward, unchanged)

Pre-existing test failures in events.rs (threshold_events_emit_with_cause_codes, threshold_events_are_deduplicated_per_day) and overfeeding_effects.rs are not caused by this task's changes — confirmed by running tests on the stashed clean state

steps.description: In crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs line 274, added `let _alk_budget = (alk_budget - comammox_alk_cost).max(0.0);` after the DO budget decrement, with a comment explaining why the assignment is prefixed with underscore (NOB does not currently read alk_budget but future guilds may).

In crates/tank_tui/src/lib.rs line 237, replaced `serde_json::from_str::<SaveFile>(&raw)` with `SaveFile::from_json(&raw)` so that TUI disk loads run through the migration chain, version checks, and stability_tracker reseeding.

Verified both changes with `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` (10/10 pass), `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` (zero warnings), and `cargo fmt --check` (no diffs in changed files; only pre-existing formatting in chemistry.rs from concurrent task tanksim-6e5.3.2).

validation_evidence: cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load: all 10 save_load tests pass
cargo test across all non-events/non-overfeeding suites: all pass (events and overfeeding failures are pre-existing, confirmed by running against stashed clean state)
cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_tui -- -D warnings: zero warnings (the _alk_budget prefix suppresses the unused assignment warning)
cargo fmt --check: only diffs are in chemistry.rs from concurrent task tanksim-6e5.3.2, not from this task's changes
